metadata.title: Optimize Responsive Design for All Devices

story.iWant: the app to work perfectly on my device
story.soThat: the experience is seamless regardless of screen size
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Audit current responsive design implementation (AC: All) - [ ] Review all components for Tailwind responsive utilities - [ ] Identify any missing responsive classes - [ ] Test current breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- [ ] Task 2: Optimize mobile layout (320px-767px) (AC: 1) - [ ] Ensure single-column layout throughout - [ ] Verify full-width input field on mobile - [ ] Check touch target sizes (minimum 44x44px) - [ ] Verify 16px base font size for readability
- [ ] Task 3: Optimize tablet layout (768px-1024px) (AC: 2) - [ ] Implement centered layout with comfortable spacing - [ ] Adjust input field width (~400px) - [ ] Verify answer card spacing and padding
- [ ] Task 4: Optimize desktop layout (1025px+) (AC: 3) - [ ] Implement max-width constraint (~600-800px) - [ ] Center content with generous padding - [ ] Optimize input field width (~500px) - [ ] Add appropriate spacing for large screens
- [ ] Task 5: Verify text readability across all breakpoints (AC: 4) - [ ] Check base font size is 16px minimum - [ ] Test text scaling on mobile devices - [ ] Ensure no text requires zooming to read - [ ] Verify typography hierarchy across breakpoints
- [ ] Task 6: Verify touch target sizes (AC: 5) - [ ] Audit all buttons for 44x44px minimum - [ ] Check input field touch target size - [ ] Verify any clickable elements meet accessibility standards - [ ] Test with actual touch on mobile devices
- [ ] Task 7: Test for horizontal scrolling (AC: 6) - [ ] Test at 320px (smallest mobile) - [ ] Test at common breakpoints (375px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px) - [ ] Fix any overflow issues - [ ] Verify content fits within viewport
- [ ] Task 8: Test interactive elements on touch devices (AC: 7) - [ ] Test all buttons on iOS Safari - [ ] Test all buttons on Chrome Mobile - [ ] Verify input keyboard behavior - [ ] Check scroll and swipe interactions
- [ ] Task 9: Cross-device testing (AC: All) - [ ] Test on real iPhone (small screen) - [ ] Test on real iPad (tablet) - [ ] Test on Android phone - [ ] Test on desktop browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox) - [ ] Document any device-specific issues

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: **Given** the app should work on mobile, tablet, and desktop **When** I test across different device sizes **Then** mobile (320px-767px): single-column layout, touch-optimized **And** tablet (768px-1024px): centered layout, comfortable spacing **And** desktop (1025px+): centered content, maximum width constraint **And** all text is readable without zooming (minimum 16px base) **And** touch targets meet 44x44px minimum size requirement **And** no horizontal scrolling at any breakpoint **And** all interactive elements are accessible on touch devices

constraint.title: Mobile-First Approach
constraint.description: Design for small screens first, then progressively enhance for larger screens
constraint.implementation: Use Tailwind's mobile-first responsive utilities (default classes apply to mobile, prefix with breakpoint for larger screens)

constraint.title: Single-Column Layout
constraint.description: Maintain single-column layout across all breakpoints to preserve app simplicity
constraint.implementation: Do not introduce multi-column layouts at any breakpoint; only adjust spacing, sizing, and centering

constraint.title: Minimum Touch Target Size
constraint.description: All interactive elements must meet 44x44px minimum touch target size
constraint.implementation: Buttons and inputs must have h-12 (48px) or h-14 (56px) minimum height; width should accommodate touch

constraint.title: Minimum Base Font Size
constraint.description: Base font size must be 16px minimum for readability without zooming
constraint.implementation: Verify Tailwind base size is 16px (default), never use smaller than text-base (16px) for body text

constraint.title: No Horizontal Scrolling
constraint.description: Content must fit within viewport width at all breakpoints (320px to 1920px+)
constraint.implementation: Use max-w-* utilities to constrain content, avoid fixed widths, test at 320px minimum width

constraint.title: No Layout Shift
constraint.description: Responsive design changes must not cause cumulative layout shift (CLS)
constraint.source: PRD Performance Requirements, Core Web Vitals
constraint.implementation: Avoid changing element sizes after mount; use consistent spacing and sizing across breakpoints

constraint.title: Use Tailwind Responsive Utilities Only
constraint.description: Do not add custom CSS media queries; use Tailwind's responsive utilities
constraint.rationale: Maintains consistency with Tailwind CSS v4 architecture, easier to maintain
constraint.implementation: Use sm:, md:, lg:, xl:, 2xl: prefixes for responsive styling

constraint.title: Maintain Shadcn UI Component Compatibility
constraint.description: Responsive changes must not break Shadcn UI component behavior
constraint.rationale: Shadcn UI components have built-in responsive behavior that should be preserved
constraint.implementation: Test all components after responsive changes; do not override Shadcn base styles

constraint.title: No New Dependencies
constraint.description: Do not install new packages for responsive design; use existing Tailwind utilities
constraint.rationale: Keep bundle size minimal, leverage existing Tailwind CSS v4 capabilities
constraint.implementation: Use only Tailwind responsive utilities and existing component patterns

constraint.title: Test on Real Devices
constraint.description: Responsive design must be validated on real iOS and Android devices, not just browser DevTools
constraint.rationale: Browser DevTools don't perfectly simulate touch behavior, viewport rendering, and mobile browser quirks
constraint.implementation: Test on actual iPhone, iPad, Android phone; use BrowserStack if real devices unavailable

constraint.title: Test All Key Breakpoints
constraint.rationale: Covers common device sizes (iPhone SE, iPhone 14, iPad, desktop)
constraint.implementation: Use browser DevTools responsive mode to test each breakpoint; verify no horizontal scrolling or layout breaks

pattern.name: Responsive Design
pattern.description: Mobile-first responsive design using Tailwind CSS responsive utilities
pattern.implementation: - Breakpoints: mobile (default), sm: 640px, md: 768px, lg: 1024px, xl: 1280px, 2xl: 1536px - Mobile-first: Base styles apply to mobile, responsive prefixes enhance for larger screens - Single-column layout: Maintains simplicity across all breakpoints - Progressive enhancement: Add spacing, sizing, and centering for larger screens

pattern.name: Touch Optimization
pattern.implementation: - Minimum 44x44px touch targets (WCAG 2.1 AA) - No hover-dependent interactions - Appropriate input types for mobile keyboards (type="text" for location) - Large buttons: h-12 (48px) or h-14 (56px) minimum - Generous spacing between interactive elements

pattern.name: Typography Scaling
pattern.description: Responsive typography that scales across breakpoints
pattern.implementation: - Base font size: 16px (text-base) - Headings scale with responsive utilities: text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl - Body text: text-base or text-lg minimum - Never use text-sm or smaller for body content - Line height adjusts automatically with Tailwind defaults

existingImplementation.currentState: - Landing page (app/page.tsx) has responsive classes for heading, subheading, padding - Input and button have responsive heights (h-12 sm:h-14) - Footer has responsive spacing - Content uses max-w-2xl for centering - Components (AnswerDisplay, ErrorDisplay, LoadingState) use Shadcn UI with default responsive behavior
existingImplementation.gaps: - Need to audit all components for missing responsive utilities - Verify touch target sizes meet 44x44px minimum (some components may be too small) - Test horizontal scrolling at 320px minimum width - Validate text readability across all breakpoints (especially small screens) - Ensure glassmorphic effects (DetailCard) work on mobile devices - Check that all interactive elements are touch-friendly (no hover-only interactions)
existingImplementation.strengths: - Already uses Tailwind responsive utilities extensively - Mobile-first approach already implemented - Shadcn UI components have built-in responsive behavior - No fixed widths that would break responsive layout - Clean, minimal design makes responsive optimization straightforward

testingStrategy.approach: Manual testing on real devices and browser DevTools
testingStrategy.tools: - Chrome DevTools Device Mode (responsive testing) - Real iOS device (iPhone SE or newer) - Real Android device (standard phone) - iPad or Android tablet - Desktop browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
testingStrategy.testCases: 1. Mobile (320px-767px): Single-column layout, touch-optimized, readable text 2. Tablet (768px-1024px): Centered layout, comfortable spacing 3. Desktop (1025px+): Max-width constraint, generous padding 4. Touch target verification: All buttons/inputs ≥ 44x44px 5. Text readability: No zooming required, 16px base minimum 6. Horizontal scrolling: None at any breakpoint 7. Interactive elements: Work with touch (no hover-only functionality)
